verdict.rationale: Hightouch's own docs show that syncs run on a recurring schedule or trigger, which is a real recurring schedule rather than one-off runs, and that run outcomes and failure alerts are reported. The evidence is limited to sync jobs and gives no detail on schedule configuration, and it does not show schedules being set via the API or MCP. missing for 10: documented schedule options (cron/interval granularity), evidence of creating or editing schedules programmatically via API/MCP for AI-native workflows, scheduling beyond syncs (e.g. journeys), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: A sync runs on the schedule or trigger you set, then reports the outcome of each run so you can confirm it worked.
Sync to 300\+ destinations in real-time or on a recurring schedule.
Sync modeled data to sales, support, analytics, and internal tools on a schedule or when data changes.
